description: MisarSEO's own retained daily GA4 landing-page breakdown for the connected property: sessions/engagement/conversions per landing page, ordered by sessions descending within each day. Read-only and FREE (no credits), archive-only — same sync/quota story as get_ga4_performance_summary.

limit.description: Rows to return, 1-1000 (default 1000). Landing-page cardinality is unbounded for a large site.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_ga4_landing_pages
